title: Relative Tor bound on one strictly perfect chart
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $G,K$ complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Suppose $QK\cong E\otimes^{\mathbf L}QG$ [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open and $L$ a strictly perfect complex on the localized open site of $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], with $E|_U\cong QL$. Let $a,b,c,d\in\mathbf Z$ bound the terms of $L$ and $G$ in $[a,b]$ and $[c,d]$, and assume every term of $G$ is flat over $S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Put $R=f^{-1}\mathcal O_S$. For every K-flat complex $P$ of $R$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] and quasi-isomorphism $q:P\to K|_R$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], every $R$-module sheaf $F$, every integer $i<a+c$ or $i>b+d$, and every open $V\subseteq U$, the module of sections over $V$ of $H^i(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R F[0]))$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is zero. No compactness or quasi-coherence is assumed.

proof.text: On the specified open U, the given isomorphism identifies E with the bounded strictly perfect complex L. Its terms are direct summands of finite free modules, hence flat over O_U. Bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat. Thus L tensor G|_U computes the restriction of the derived tensor. The total degree n is the sum over p+q=n; outside [a+c,b+d], either p is outside [a,b] or q is outside [c,d], and every summand is zero.

source.place: Tag 0DJQ, proof, local relative Tor verification; Tag 08CI, implication (2) to (1); Tag 08CG

proof.text: Fix x in U and an affine neighbourhood V of f(x). Affine neighbourhoods W of x contained in f^{-1}V form a filtered neighbourhood basis. The hypothesis makes G^q(W) flat over O_S(V). Their filtered colimit is the stalk G^q_x and is flat over O_S(V). The canonical O_{S,f(x)} action restricts to this action, and O_{S,f(x)} is a localization of O_S(V); the localization flatness criterion therefore gives flatness over O_{S,f(x)}. This is the stalk of the inverse-image base ring. Tensoring with L^p gives a retract of a finite direct sum of G^q|_U, so the total model is termwise flat over the inverse-image base ring. Its boundedness makes it K-flat over that ring.

source.place: Tag 0DJQ, proof, local relative Tor verification; Tag 08CI, implication (2) to (1); Tag 08CG

proof.text: Exact open restriction commutes with the direct-sum total tensor and its cohomology and preserves K-flatness (apply the ringed-space pullback preservation theorem to the open inclusion with the inverse-image base ring). The given global quasi-isomorphism q and representative isomorphism eK identify P|_U with the local bounded relatively flat model in the derived category of base-ring modules. Independence of K-flat resolutions identifies their derived tensors with every F|_U. The latter has zero terms, hence zero cohomology, outside [a+c,b+d]. The restriction to U of the global homology sheaf is therefore zero. Its sections on every V contained in U vanish. Empty opens are vacuous; reversed intervals force one of the bounded factors to vanish and give the same conclusion.

theorem strictPerfect_tensor_relativeTor_bound
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (G K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eK : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hL : IsStrictlyPerfect X U L)
    (eL : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)
    (a b c d : ℤ)
    (hLb : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (L.X n))
    (hGb : ∀ n : ℤ, n < c ∨ d < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, Modules.IsFlatOver (G.X n) f) :
    let R := TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base S.sheaf
    let A := (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} A) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := R) P →
      ∀ q : P ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
              (Modules.tensorPullbackRingMap f))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K,
        QuasiIso q → ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} A) (i : ℤ),
          i < a + c ∨ b + d < i → ∀ (V : X.Opens), V ≤ U →
            IsZero ((SheafOfModules.evaluation A (Opposite.op V)).obj
              ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
                ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)
                (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R))).homology i))
